name: Important Terms and Reading Instruction
text: THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THIS CREDIT SERVICES AGREEMENT (“AGREEMENT”) ARE IMPORTANT. Please read the entire agreement.

name: Definition of Customer, Buyer, you and your
text: In this Agreement, the words “Customer,” “Buyer,” "you" and "your" mean the person that is identified under the heading “Customer” above.

name: Definition of Seller, we, us and our
text: The words “Seller,” “we,” "us," and "our" mean PLS Loan Store of Texas, Inc., a licensed Texas Credit Access Business (‘CAB’), operating pursuant to Chapter 393 of the Texas Finance Code (“Chapter 393").

name: Definition of lender
text: The lender from whom the extension of consumer credit is obtained is DSI Lending Resources, Inc.

name: Description of Our Services – lender and fiduciary disclaimer
text: Description of Our Services: We are not a lender or fiduciary.

name: Description of Our Services – primary CAB services
text: For the CAB fee set forth below, we will attempt to (1) obtain a loan in the amount and for the term set forth below from DSI Lending Resources, Inc., a third party lender, with a contract rate of interest of no more than ten percent per annum (10%); (2) issue a letter of credit ("LOC") to secure that loan; and (3) assist you in preparing and completing documents necessary to obtain the loan.

name: Description of Our Services – performance period
text: The estimated period for performing these services shall be one day.

name: Description of Our Services – additional services
text: Additionally, we will also attempt to: (4) assist you in making your payments timely by providing a reminder service; (5) upon request, provide consumer financial education materials; (6) where available, provide discounted check cashing services to facilitate payment(s); and (7) maintain a network of branch locations to provide certain CAB services.

name: Description of Our Services – additional-services term
text: These additional services may be provided throughout the term.

name: Description of Our Services – no loan promise
text: We do not promise that you will actually receive a loan,

name: Description of Our Services – third-party credit decisions
text: All credit decisions shall be made by a third party lender.

name: Description of Our Services – no fee upon denial
text: HOWEVER, YOU WILL NOT OWE US A FEE IF YOUR LOAN APPLICATION IS DENIED BY THE LENDER.

name: Description of Our Services – finance-charge variability
text: The precise amount of your finance charge will depend upon the amount that the lender allows you to borrow, and the term of the loan.

name: Description of Our Services – alternative credit disclosure
text: You have been advised that our CAB services and the third party loan, if any, you receive may not be at the lowest rate or best terms available, and that you may look elsewhere for credit services and a loan.

name: Description of Our Services – debt-collection compliance
text: A credit access business must comply with Chapter 392 and the federal Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (15 U.S.C. Section 1692 et seq.) with respect to an extension of consumer credit described by Section 393.602(a).

name: Description of Our Services – military lending compliance
text: A credit access business must comply, to the extent applicable, with 10 U.S.C. Section 987 and any regulations adopted under that law with respect to an extension of consumer credit described by Section 393.602(a).

name: Description of Our Services – LOC not open-ended
text: You acknowledge that CAB's letter of credit, which secures your repayment of the loan on its due date, is not open-ended in nature.

name: Description of Our Services – refinancing condition
text: The maturity of the loan may not be extended without you, Lender, and CAB agreeing to enter into a refinancing transaction, with new disclosures and documents, and with Lender and CAB being entitled to additional charges.

name: Disclosure of Fee as Finance Charge
text: Disclosure of Fee as Finance Charge: Although the fee that we charge you is not interest, the Federal Truth in Lending Act requires that it be included in the finance charge calculation for your loan.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – CAB fee rate
text: COST AND PAYMENT TERMS. Our CAB fee is based upon °% annualized rate on the amount financed on the loan to you by the Lender.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – earning and payment of CAB fee
text: Our CAB fee is earned in advance at the inception of the loan, and is payable as part of the scheduled payments with the Joan payments, subject to a partial rebate of the CAB Fee as set forth below in the event of prepayment in full.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – loan and finance-charge disclosure
text: On the payday installment loan of $___ you have applied for, payable in _ payments with interest of 10.00% per annum charged by the Lender, the Amount Financed is $ , the Finance Charge is

name: Cost and Payment Terms – components of finance charge
text: The Finance Charge consists of the interest paid or to be paid to the Lender, in the amount of $_ and our CAB fee for this transaction ofS

name: Cost and Payment Terms – APR and payment schedule
text: The Annual Percentage Rate is %, payments commencing on , in the amount of $ , followed by regular payments of $ each, with a final payment of $ on , and the Total of Payments is

name: Cost and Payment Terms – application of payments
text: Payments will be applied first to the CAB fee, then to interest, late charges, returned item fees and principal in that order.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – partial prepayments
text: Any partial prepayments will not allow you to skip scheduled payments, but might cause an adjustment to the timing and amount of the final payment or payments.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – CAB fee refund
text: You will be entitled to a refund of part of the CAB fee based on a prorated daily basis for the final period with respect to payment in full.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – early payoff
text: Under any loan that we may obtain for you, if you pay off your loan early, you will not have to pay a penalty and your finance charge may be reduced.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – no prepayment penalty
text: There is no prepayment penalty.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – refinancing proceeds
text: If the transaction is a refinancing transaction, the amount you receive is applied to your prior account with the Lender that is being refinanced,

name: Cost and Payment Terms – CAB reimbursement and fees
text: Besides the CAB fees, you are responsible to reimburse CAB for any amounts CAB pays the Lender on the letter of credit, plus 10% per annum until the reimbursement is paid, a return item fee of $30 (or the State Allowed Returned Item Fee, whichever is greater) for any check, ACH debit, electronic check, or other payment device that is returned unpaid, attorneys’ fees, and costs of collection.

name: Cost and Payment Terms – lender charges and fees
text: Besides interest to the Lender, you would be responsible to the Lender for a late charge equal to the greater of 5% of the payment amount (on the principal and interest only) or $7.50, if payment is 10 or more days late, a return item fee of $30 (or the State Allowed Returned Item Fee, whichever is greater) for any check, ACH debit, electronic check, or other payment device that is returned unpaid, and attorneys’ fees, and costs of collection.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – LOC request
text: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse: You request us to issue our irrevocable LOC in favor of the third party lender as beneficiary in accordance with Chapter 5 of the Texas Business and Commerce Code, in an amount not to exceed principal, interest, returned item fee, and late fee, as applicable, on the loan that we arrange for you.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – reimbursement obligation
text: You agree to pay us any amounts paid by us to third parties pursuant to the LOC.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – presentment conditions
text: Our payment on the LOC to the lender is conditioned upon presentment by the lender to us of (a) the lender's sight draft, and (b) the lender's statement that your loan is in default and has been in default at least 10 days from its due date.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – expiration
text: The LOC will expire the earlier of 175 days after maturity of the loan we arrange for you or the date the loan is paid in full.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – cancellation revocation
text: If you timely exercise your right to cancel this Agreement, our LOC shall be automatically revoked and shall have no further effect.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – payment instruction
text: You instruct us to pay the lender's sight draft up to the maximum amount of the LOC upon presentation to us of documentation complying with the conditions set forth above.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – documentary presentment duty
text: You understand that we are not responsible for determining the accuracy of any statement made by the lender/ LOC beneficiary and that our duty is strictly to pay upon proper presentment of documents.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – lawful amounts
text: No part of this Agreement, nor any charge or receipt by us, is intended to permit us to impose any amount in excess of lawful amounts.

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – unlawful excess
text: If an unlgyuful excess occurs, we will apply it as a credit or otherwise refund it and the rate or amount involved will automatically be reduced to the maximug peepee law,

name: LOC and Obligation to Reimburse – calculation of charges
text: for purposes of determining our compliance with law, we may calculate charges by amortiz

name: Default – events of default
text: DEFAULT: You will be in default under this Agreement if (1) you do not pay us what you owe us under this Agreement on or before the payment date; (2) if you fail to perform your other promises to us; or (3) you fail to perform your obligations to the Lender.

name: Default – remedies
text: If you default, your obligations, less any unearned charges, will become immediately due and payable, and you agree that we shall have the right to take any of the following actions to the extent allowed by applicable law: (1) we shall have the right to seek collection of any check or similar security you have provided us; and (2) we may exercise any other right or remedy allowed by law and this Agreement.

name: Notices and Waivers – notices waived
text: NOTICES AND WAIVERS: Except for notices provided in this Agreement, you, and others responsible, to the extent permitted by law, waive demand, notice of nonpayment, notice of intention to accelerate, notice of acceleration, presentment, and notice of dishonor.

name: Notices and Waivers – delayed enforcement
text: To the extent permitted by law, you, and others responsible, also agree: we may waive or delay enforcing our rights without losing them;

name: Notices and Waivers – collection diligence
text: we are not required to file suit or arbitrate, show diligence in collection against you or others responsible, or go against any collateral;

name: Notices and Waivers – release or modification of liability
text: we may release or modify any person’s liability without changing the liability of others;

name: Notices and Waivers – substitution or release of collateral
text: we may substitute, exchange or release any collateral;

name: Notices and Waivers – proceedings against fewer than all persons
text: and we may sue or arbitrate with one or more persons without joining or suing others.

name: Waiver of Right to Trial by Jury – acknowledgment
text: WAIVER OF RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY: You acknowledge that there is a constitutional right to trial by jury but it may be waived under certain circumstances.

name: Waiver of Right to Trial by Jury – waiver
text: To the extent permitted by law, you, us, and Lender, knowingly and voluntarily waive any right to trial by jury in the event of litigation arising out of or related to this Agreement.

name: Waiver of Right to Trial by Jury – arbitration unaffected
text: This jury trial waiver shall not affect or be interpreted as modifying in any fashion the Arbitration Agreement and Limitation on Class Participation if you do not reject that Arbitration Agreement and Limitation on Class Participation.

name: Compliance – intention to comply
text: COMPLIANCE: It is the intention of CAB and Lender to comply with applicable Jaw.

name: Compliance – rights limited by law
text: In each and every instance, CAB’s and Lender's respective rights are limited by applicable law (to the extent they may not be lawfully waived), construed so as to comply with applicable laws, and CAB's and Lender's rights may not be exercised except to the extent permitted by applicable law.

name: Compliance – no unlawful charge intended
text: No charge or receipt by CAB or Lender, or any other person on CAB's or Lender's behalf’, is intended to exceed lawful amounts.

name: Compliance – unlawful excess remedy
text: If an unlawful excess occurs, it will be applied as a credit or otherwise refunded, and the rate or amount involved will automatically be reduced to the maximum lawful rate or amount.

name: Compliance – calculation of charges
text: To the extent permitted by law, for purposes of determining CAB's and Lender's compliance with the law, CAB and Lender may calculate charges by amortizing, prorating, allocating and spreading.

name: Pre-Suit Notice Regarding Legal Compliance – notice and cure
text: PRE-SUIT NOTICE REGARDING LEGAL COMPLIANCE: Prior to initiating any claim that this agreement or related matter, or any action or inaction by us or Lender, or by any other person, is legally non-compliant, illegal or unenforceable, you must provide us and Lender with detailed written notice of the claim and relief requested and a reasonable opportunity of not less than 60 days to cure the claim.

name: Pre-Suit Notice Regarding Legal Compliance – delivery address
text: Any notice to us or to Lender must be sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, to PLS Loan Store of Texas, Inc., Attn: Legal Department, One South Wacker Drive, Suite 3600, Chicago, IL 60606.

name: Pre-Suit Notice Regarding Legal Compliance – corrective action
text: Any corrective action shall relieve us and Lender of any liability to the extent permitted by law.

name: Pre-Suit Notice Regarding Legal Compliance – cumulative requirement
text: To the extent permitted by law, this requirement for pre-suit notice is cumulative of any notices and corrective-action procedures required by applicable law and other contract provisions.

name: Collection Expenses – attorneys’ fees and costs
text: Collection Expenses: You agree to pay our reasonable attorneys’ fees if this Agreement is referred to an attorney for collection, regardless of whether legal proceedings are actually filed, and all costs and disbursements.

name: Collection Expenses – criminal-charge restriction
text: A person may not threaten or pursue criminal charges against you related to a check or other debit authorization provided by the consumer as security for a loan, in the absence of forgery, fraud, theft, or other criminal conduct.

name: Interstate Commerce
text: Interstate Commerce: You agree that this Agreement involves interstate commerce for all purposes.

name: Assignment – transfer by Seller
text: Assignment: We may transfer any of our rights, titles and interests under this Agreement at our discretion.

name: Assignment – transfer by Customer
text: You may not transfer your rights under this Agreement without our prior written consent.

name: Miscellaneous – principal place of business
text: Miscellaneous: Our principal place of business is PLS Loan Store of Texas, Inc., One South Wacker Drive, Suite 3600, Chicago, IL 60606,

name: Miscellaneous – Texas agent for service
text: Our agent in Texas authorized to receive service of process is: National Registered Agents, Inc., 16055 Space Center Blvd., Suite 235, Houston, Texas 77062.

name: Miscellaneous – phone number
text: Our phone number is 312-491-7300.

name: Arbitration Agreement and Limitation on Class Participation – agreement to arbitrate
text: ARBITRATION AGREEMENT AND LIMITATION ON CLASS PARTICIPATION, PLEASE READ CAREFULLY, THIS PROVISION AFFECTS AND LIMITS YOUR RIGHTS! You and we agree to arbitrate Claims instead of having them decided in court. You and we agree to arbitrate as follows:

name: Unnumbered — Definition of Claim
text: Definition of Claim. "Claim" means any dispute, claim or controversy between you and us and/or Lender arising from or relating to: (a) the current credit services agreement, loan, agreement, or obligation; (b) any prior credit services agreement, loan or agreement between you and us and/or Lender; (c) any products or services offered to you by us and/or Lender; (d) the actions of you, us, Lender, or third parties, including claims for money damages, penalties or equitable relief or (e) the validity of this arbitration agreement.

name: Definition of we and us for arbitration
text: For the purposes of this arbitration agreement, "we" and “us” also include our officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates and shareholders or owners.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – binding arbitration
text: Starting an Arbitration/Costs. Upon the election by either you, us, or Lender, any Claim shall be resolved by binding arbitration in accordance with this arbitration provision and the rules of the arbitration organization that is selected.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – notice of election
text: Either you, we, or Lender may give written notice to the other of an intention to require arbitration of the other party's Claim at any time, even if the other party has begun a lawsuit.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – judgment limitation
text: If a judgment has been entered in a lawsuit involving you, us, or Lender, however, then neither we, you, nor Lender, as applicable, can demand arbitration on the matters included in the judgment.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – selection by Customer
text: After notice by either party to the other, you may select the arbitration organization of your choice from: American Arbitration Association, 335 Madison Avenue, New York, NY 10017, www.adr.org , (800) 778-7879; JAMS 1920 Main Street, Suite 300, Irvine, CA 92614, www.jamsadr.com , 800-352-5267; or any other arbitrator (including an attorney, retired judge, or an arbitrator registered and in good standing with an arbitration association) reasonably satisfactory to us. If

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – selection after 20 days
text: If you do not select an arbitrator within 20 days after notice, we shall be entitled to select one.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – court appointment
text: If the named organization will not conduct the arbitration according to this provision, or if we are not able to agree on another arbitrator, you agree that we may ask any court of competent jurisdiction to appoint an arbitrator to conduct the arbitration in accordance with this arbitration agreement.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – individual-arbitrator selection rules
text: The individual arbitrator shall be chosen in accordance with the rules of the selected arbitration organization, but if that organization or arbitrator has no published rules, then in accordance with the Rules of the AAA for Consumer Arbitrations.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – class-action organizations excluded
text: You, we, and Lender agree that any arbitration organization that permits class actions in arbitration may not be selected to arbitrate Claims.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – advancement of fees
text: If you ask us to, we or Lender, as applicable, will advance all or part of the arbitration filing, administrative, and/or hearing fees required for the arbitration, up to $1000;

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – ultimate fee responsibility
text: the arbitrator will decide whether we, you or Lender, as applicable, will ultimately be responsible to pay those fees.

name: Starting an Arbitration/Costs – reimbursement cap
text: In no event will you be required to reimburse us or Lender, as applicable, for any arbitration filing, administrative and/or hearing fees in an amount greater than what your court costs would have been if the Claim had been resolved in a state court with jurisdiction.

name: Arbitration Procedure – Federal Arbitration Act
text: Arbitration Procedure. This arbitration agreement shall be governed by the Federal Arbitration Act, 9 U.S.C. §1, et seq., as amended.

name: Arbitration Procedure – hearing location
text: Any arbitration hearing at which you must appear in person will take place within the county that includes your address at the time the Claim is filed, the county in which the credit services office that arranged the loan to you is located or such other location as we or Lender may agree.

name: Arbitration Procedure – applicable law and procedural rules
text: The arbitrator (the person or people who decide the Claim) will apply relevant law; however, the arbitrator will not apply federal or state rules of civil procedure or evidence,

name: Arbitration Procedure – documentary and telephone proceedings
text: Unless the arbitrator determines that an in-person hearing would be preferable, you, we and Lender agree that the arbitrator may base his or her decisions on documentary submissions and, if appearance of the parties is necessary, that such appearance may be made by telephone.

name: Arbitration Procedure – written opinion
text: The decision of the arbitrator will be made by written opinion.

name: Arbitration Procedure – party expenses
text: You, we and Lender shall be responsible for each of its own expenses, including postage, transportation, attorneys, experts, and witnesses, unless the arbitrator decides differently under applicable law.

name: Arbitration Procedure – judgment on decision
text: After the arbitrator makes a decision, you, we or Lender, as applicable, may apply to any court having jurisdiction to enter a judgment based on the decision of the arbitrator.

name: Arbitration Procedure – deemed place of decision
text: For purposes of obtaining a judgment on an arbitration award, the decision shall be deemed to have been made in the judicial district (state or federal court, as applicable) for your home address at the time the arbitration decision is rendered.

name: Opting Out of Arbitration – right to opt out
text: Opting Out of Arbitration. If you do not wish for Claims arising under this Agreement to be subject to arbitration, you may opt out of this arbitration provision.

name: Opting Out of Arbitration – notice procedure
text: To opt out, you must write us within 30 days of the date of this Agreement at PLS Financial Services, Attn: Legal Department, One South Wacker Drive, Suite 3600, Chicago, IL 60606, identifying this credit services agreement and tell us of your decision to opt out.

name: Opting Out of Arbitration – written notice required
text: You must give notice in writing; it is not sufficient to telephone us.

name: Opting Out of Arbitration – scope of exclusion
text: Only those disputes, claims, or controversies arising under this Agreement will be excluded from arbitration.

name: Opting Out of Arbitration – other transactions
text: Claims in connection with prior or subsequent transactions are subject to arbitration according to the terms of the agreements governing those transactions, including their opt out provisions.

name: No Jury Trial – effect of arbitration election
text: No Jury Trial. If arbitration is chosen by either you, us, or Lender, the arbitrator will make a decision outside of court and without a jury, and neither you nor we will be able to litigate that Claim in court or have a jury trial on that Claim.

name: No Jury Trial – opt-out instruction
text: If you desire to present any potential Claim to a court or jury, you should opt out of this arbitration provision.

name: Class Action Limitation – class waiver
text: Class Action Limitation. If either you, we, or Lender, as applicable, choose arbitration, all Claims must be arbitrated and you expressly waive your right to join or represent any class of claimants.

name: Class Action Limitation – no class participation
text: THIS MEANS YOU MAY NOT PARTICIPATE IN A CLASS ACTION OR A CLASS-WIDE ARBITRATION, EITHER AS A REPRESENTATIVE OR MEMBER OF ANY CLASS OF CLAIMANTS PERTAINING TO ANY CLAIM EVEN IF A CLASS ACTION HAS BEEN FILED AND IS PENDING CERTIFICATION.

name: Class Action Limitation – individual scope
text: This arbitration agreement is intended to resolve all Claims between you as an individual and us and/or Lender,

name: Class Action Limitation – no class procedure
text: and you, we and Lender agree that no class action procedure may be used in the arbitration proceeding.

name: Class Action Limitation – no class arbitration right
text: You do not have the right to have any Claim arbitrated as a class action

name: Class Action Limitation – no representative capacity
text: and the arbitrator shall not allow you to serve as a representative, as a private attorney general, or in any other representative capacity for others in the arbitration.

name: Class Action Limitation – no joinder or consolidation
text: No joinder or consolidation of parties will be permitted in any arbitration.

name: Class Action Limitation – organization acceptance requirement
text: Any arbitration organization that does not accept this class action waiver may not be selected to arbitrate Claims,

name: Arbitration severability
text: If any part of this arbitration agreement or the application of this arbitration agreement to any particular Claim or subject matter is held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remainder of this arbitration agreement and the application of this arbitration agreement to any other Claims will remain valid and enforceable.

name: Conflict with arbitration organization code
text: In the event of a conflict between the arbitration organization's code and this arbitration agreement, this arbitration agreement controls.

name: Governing Law
text: GOVERNING LAW: This Credit Services Agreement will be governed by the laws of the State of Texas, except that the Arbitration Agreement and Limitation on Class Participation is governed by the Federal Arbitration Act (FAA’).

name: Caution regarding short-term use and alternatives
text: CAUTION: THE CREDIT SERVICES WE PROVIDE AND THE LOAN WE MAY ARRANGE FROM LENDER ARE NOT INTENDED TO MEET LONG-TERM FINANCIAL NEEDS. SUCH CREDIT SERVICES AND LOAN SHOULD ONLY BE USED TO MEET IMMEDIATE SHORT-TERM CASH NEEDS. REPEATED OR FREQUENT USE CAN CREATE SERIOUS FINANCIAL HARDSHIPS. BEFORE ENTERING ANY AGREEMENT OR A SPECIFIC TRANSACTION, YOU SHOULD EVALUATE THE COSTS AND BENEFITS OF ALL ALTERNATIVES, INCLUDING A LOAN FROM ANOTHER LENDER (WITHOUT THE ASSISTANCE OF A CAB), A LOAN FROM FAMILY OR FRIENDS, A CREDIT CARD CASH ADVANCE, AN ADVANCE UNDER AN ACCOUNT WITH OVERDRAFT PROTECTION, OR A SALARY ADVANCE,

name: Consumer complaint contact
text: For complaints against this or any other Credit Access Business, please contact the Texas Office of Consumer Credit Commissioner's Consumer Assistance Help-line at 800.538.1579, by e-mail at consumer.complaints@occc.state.tx.us, or by mail at 2601 N. Lamar Blvd., Austin, Texas 78705.

name: Entire Agreement – integration
text: ENTIRE AGREEMENT: This Agreement is the entire agreement between you and us relating to the subject matter of this Agreement.

name: Entire Agreement – modifications
text: No modification of this Agreement shall be effective unless in writing and signed by you and us.

name: Entire Agreement – severability and reformation
text: If any provision of this Agreement is determined to be invalid or unenforceable, such provision shall be reformed if practicable so as to achieve its intended purpose(s) and shall not in any way affect the remaining provisions of this Agreement.

name: Signing acknowledgments – documents received and retained
text: By signing below: (a) YOU ACKNOWLEDGE THAT YOU HAVE RECEIVED, READ and RETAINED A COPY OF (1) A SEPARATE CREDIT SERVICES DISCLOSURE STATEMENT: (2) THIS CREDIT SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH ALL NECESSARY SPACES COMPLETED; (3) TWO NOTICES OF CANCELLATION:

name: Signing acknowledgments – agreement to terms
text: (b) you certify that you have read, understood and agree to all of the terms and conditions of this Credit Services Agreement, including the binding Arbitration Agreement and Limitation on Class Participation;

name: Signing acknowledgments – accuracy of information
text: (c) you certify that all of the information you have provided in connection with this Credit Services Agreement is true and correct;

name: Signing acknowledgments – bankruptcy warranty
text: (d) you warrant that you are not a debtor under any proceeding in bankruptcy, and have no intention to file a petition for relief under the United States Bankruptcy Code;

name: Signing acknowledgments – payment-account warranty
text: you warrant that the account on which any check, ACH debit, electronic check, or similar payment device that you provide to us is drawn, is a legitimate, open, and active account;

name: Signing acknowledgments – information sharing
text: (f) you agree that we may obtain and share any information you provide to us or that we obtain from third parties in connection with this Credit Services Agreement, including credit information and credit reports, with the third party lender or our affiliates, for the duration of the services or any subsequent services.

name: Cancellation Notice
text: NOTICE: YOU, THE BUYER, MAY CANCEL THIS CONTRACT AT ANY TIME BEFORE MIDNIGHT OF THE THIRD DAY AFTER THE DATE OF THE TRANSACTION. SEE ATTACHED NOTICE OF CANCELLATION FORM (TWO COPIES ATTACHED) FOR AN EXPLANATION OF THIS RIGHT.

name: Notice of Cancellation – right to cancel
text: You may cancel this contract, without any penalty or obligation, within three days after the date the contract is signed.

name: Notice of Cancellation – return of payment
text: If you cancel, any payment made by you under this contract will be returned within 10 days after the date of receipt by the seller of your cancellation notice.

name: Notice of Cancellation – cancellation procedure
text: To cancel this contract, mail or deliver a signed dated copy of this cancellation notice, or other written notice, to: PLS Loan Store of Texas, Inc., Attention: CAB Cancellation, PLS Loan Store of Texas, Inc., One South Wacker Drive, Suite 3600, Chicago, IL 60606 not later than midnight on
